attributes.check1: Intelligence or Ranged or Craft or Divine 15
attributes.name: Blessed Bullet
attributes.powers:
Display this card; you may not do so during an encounter. After playing this card, if you have more than 2 cards that have the Ammunition trait displayed, recharge 1 of them.

While displayed, when you play a card that has the Firearm trait on your combat check and you would fail that check, you may bury this card to reroll the dice and add another 1d12 and the Divine and Magic traits; take the new result. You may succeed at a Craft 15 check to discard this card instead of burying it.
